Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the quality of paraphrases with: 1) alignment-based metrics to examine the semantics preservation: including BLEU, ROUGE scores and METEOR between the generated paraphrase and gold paraphrase. 2) syntactic conformation metrics: Tree-Edit Distances (TED) scores between the constituency parse trees of generated paraphrases versus exemplar sentences (TED-E) and parallel-annotated paraphrases (TED-R).
